LanguageData.LP_Feat_Slasher.label: slasher
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Slasher.description: The blade leaves long, deep wounds. Sharp (cut, scratch) damage ×1.2; hits have a 25% chance to halve the target's move speed for 3 seconds. One of slasher, piercer, crusher. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Piercer.label: piercer
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Piercer.description: Always goes for vital spots. Stab, bite, bullet and arrow damage ×1.2; such attacks have a 20% chance to deal double damage. One of slasher, piercer, crusher. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Crusher.label: crusher
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Crusher.description: One hammer blow sends man and armor flying. Blunt damage ×1.2; hits have a 25% chance to push the target 1 cell and stun for 1 second. One of slasher, piercer, crusher. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MageSlayer.label: mage slayer
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MageSlayer.description: Specializes in fighting spellcasters. ×1.3 damage against casters (DND classes, holy symbol wearers, psycasters, enemy caster units); hitting someone who is casting interrupts the cast and stuns them for 1 second; mind resistance +25%. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_DefensiveDuelist.label: defensive duelist
LanguageData.LP_Feat_DefensiveDuelist.description: A flick of the blade turns the incoming blow aside. Melee dodge +15, melee hit chance ×1.05. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_WeaponMaster.label: weapon master
LanguageData.LP_Feat_WeaponMaster.description: Any weapon feels right in your hands. Melee hit chance ×1.1, shooting accuracy ×1.1, aiming time ×0.9. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Durable.label: durable
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Durable.description: No matter how bad the wounds, back on your feet quickly. Wound healing ×1.5, rest recovery ×1.3, pain shock threshold +10%. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_FeyTouched.label: fey touched
LanguageData.LP_Feat_FeyTouched.description: Has dealt with the Feywild. Gains the ability "Misty step" (vanilla longjump: jump to a distant cell, cooldown as vanilla); mind resistance +20%, social impact ×1.1. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
